verdict.rationale: The docs show a permission-based IAM model: a roles endpoint gated by a named "View roles in account" permission, granular action permissions such as "Monitor and unmonitor customers", and API credentials with configurable permissions under Settings > Access Management. However, nothing describes how an operations lead would build roles that restrict case investigation, alert decisioning, or administrative actions to particular users. missing for 10: documented user-role creation and assignment in the web app, permission mapping for case review and decision actions, admin-versus-investigator separation guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
